# Muse Space — muse空间 (full)

Muse Space is a Muse Skill and template library with 48 ready-to-use mini-app templates for Muse Spaces, modeled on WeChat Mini Programs. Repository: https://github.com/realfshaw-crypto/muse-space. License: MIT. All templates are single-file HTML, Astryx design tokens, localStorage persistence, bilingual English/Chinese.

## Questions and answers

Q: What is Muse Space? A: A Muse Skill plus a library of 48 mini-app templates. You ask Muse for a small tool in one sentence, and Muse generates a ready-to-use Muse Space from the matching template.
Q: How is it like WeChat Mini Programs? A: Like Mini Programs, each template is a small single-purpose app that opens instantly with no install and no coding.
Q: Where is user data stored? A: Locally, in the browser localStorage of the generated Space. No data is sent to external services.
Q: What design system do the templates use? A: Meta Astryx design tokens (core defaults), semantic CSS variables with automatic light/dark adaptation.
Q: How many templates are there? A: 48 templates in 6 categories: AI Work (9), Productivity (10), Money (6), Health (4), Learn (4), Life & Home (15).

## How to use

Add the repository as a Muse Skill (SKILL.md), then say the tool name in English or Chinese, for example: Open my expense tracker, Give me a Pomodoro timer, 打开记账, 给我一个番茄钟, 打开习惯打卡. Muse reads templates.json, loads the template, fills in user data, and generates the Space.
